neighbours.label: A member of the public as the source of a contribution: the reader/customer/visitor who 'sent' or 'wrote' something, a 'Name, of Town, State,' attribution, or 'Reader comments'; quiet on the same verbs and place names with an institution or plain geography.
fire: Last month a listener in Glasgow sent us a recording of the storm.
Linda Park, of Reno, Nev., wrote to say the recipe worked perfectly.
